name: Fastest route is unsafe
note: Synthetic demonstration scenario. Not a reconstruction of any real flood event and not validated against observations. Risk weights are authored and not empirically calibrated.
expected_effects: the fastest route is flagged unsafe
the safe route is longer but avoids deep water and unassessed bridges
assertions: safe route risk <= fastest route risk
per-segment risk contributions are exposed in the response
when no safe route exists the answer is unsafe/unavailable, not fastest-with-warning
